function attributeNamespacesCase(variant) {
  const checks = {}, ns = 'urn:example:attributes', other = 'urn:example:other';
  document.body.innerHTML = '';
  const element = document.createElement('div'); document.body.append(element);
  checks.empty = !element.hasAttributes() && element.getAttributeNames().length === 0;
  element.setAttributeNS(ns, 'p:id', 'foreign-' + variant);
  checks.lookup = element.getAttributeNS(ns, 'id') === 'foreign-' + variant && element.hasAttributeNS(ns, 'id');
  checks.qualified = element.getAttribute('p:id') === 'foreign-' + variant && element.hasAttribute('p:id');
  checks.localMissing = element.getAttribute('id') === null && element.getAttributeNS(null, 'id') === null;
  checks.idReflection = element.id === '' && window['foreign-' + variant] === undefined;
  checks.selectorId = !element.matches('#foreign-' + variant) && document.querySelector('#foreign-' + variant) === null;
  element.removeAttributeNS(ns, 'id');
  element.setAttributeNS(ns, 'id', 'unprefixed-' + variant);
  checks.unprefixed = element.getAttribute('id') === 'unprefixed-' + variant && element.getAttributeNS(ns, 'id') === 'unprefixed-' + variant;
  checks.unprefixedId = element.id === '' && window['unprefixed-' + variant] === undefined;
  checks.unprefixedSelector = !element.matches('#unprefixed-' + variant) && document.getElementById('unprefixed-' + variant) === null;
  element.id = 'actual-' + variant;
  checks.reflectedWrite = element.getAttributeNS(null, 'id') === element.id && element.getAttributeNS(ns, 'id') === 'unprefixed-' + variant;
  checks.namedId = window['actual-' + variant] === element && document.getElementById('actual-' + variant) === element;
  element.setAttributeNS(other, 'r:id', 'other');
  checks.coexist = element.getAttributeNS(other, 'id') === 'other' && element.getAttributeNS(ns, 'id') === 'unprefixed-' + variant;
  checks.orderedNames = JSON.stringify(element.getAttributeNames()) === JSON.stringify(['id', 'id', 'r:id']);
  element.setAttributeNS(ns, 'q:id', 'changed');
  checks.prefixRetained = element.getAttribute('q:id') === null && element.getAttribute('id') === 'changed' && element.getAttributeNS(ns, 'id') === 'changed';
  checks.orderRetained = JSON.stringify(element.getAttributeNames()) === JSON.stringify(['id', 'id', 'r:id']);
  element.setAttribute('id', 'qualified-change');
  checks.namedUpdate = element.getAttributeNS(ns, 'id') === 'qualified-change';
  element.removeAttribute('id');
  checks.namedRemove = element.getAttributeNS(ns, 'id') === null && element.getAttributeNS(other, 'id') === 'other' && element.id === 'actual-' + variant;
  element.removeAttributeNS(other, 'id');
  checks.nsRemove = !element.hasAttributeNS(other, 'id') && element.getAttributeNames().length === 1;
  element.setAttributeNS('', 'title', 'empty');
  checks.emptyNamespace = element.getAttributeNS(null, 'title') === 'empty' && element.getAttributeNS(undefined, 'title') === 'empty';
  element.setAttribute('DATA-UPPER', 'html');
  checks.htmlLowercase = element.getAttribute('DATA-UPPER') === 'html' && element.getAttributeNames().includes('data-upper');
  const svg = document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg', 'svg'); svg.style.display = 'block'; document.body.append(svg);
  svg.setAttribute('VIEW', 'svg');
  checks.svgCase = svg.getAttribute('VIEW') === 'svg' && svg.getAttribute('view') === null;
  svg.setAttributeNS('http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink', 'xlink:href', '#target');
  checks.xlink = svg.getAttribute('xlink:href') === '#target' && svg.getAttributeNS('http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink', 'href') === '#target';
  checks.serialize = svg.outerHTML.includes('xlink:href="#target"');
  element.setAttributeNS(ns, 'class', 'fakeClass');
  checks.foreignClass = element.className === '' && !element.matches('.fakeClass');
  element.className = 'realClass';
  checks.classWrite = element.getAttributeNS(null, 'class') === 'realClass' && element.getAttributeNS(ns, 'class') === 'fakeClass' && element.matches('.realClass');
  element.setAttributeNS(ns, 'style', 'width:99px');
  checks.foreignStyle = getComputedStyle(element).width !== '99px';
  element.setAttributeNS(null, 'style', 'width:21px');
  checks.nativeStyle = getComputedStyle(element).width === '21px';
  element.setAttributeNS(null, 'style', 'width:32px');
  checks.styleMutation = getComputedStyle(element).width === '32px';
  element.removeAttributeNS(null, 'style');
  checks.styleRemoval = getComputedStyle(element).width !== '32px';
  checks.toggle = element.toggleAttribute('data-toggle') && element.hasAttribute('data-toggle') && !element.toggleAttribute('data-toggle') && !element.hasAttribute('data-toggle');
  checks.toggleForce = !element.toggleAttribute('data-force', false) && element.toggleAttribute('data-force', true) && element.toggleAttribute('data-force', true) && element.getAttribute('data-force') === '';
  function throws(name, run) {try {run();return false} catch(error) {return error.name === name}}
  checks.namespaceError = throws('NamespaceError', () => element.setAttributeNS(null, 'p:name', 'x'));
  checks.xmlError = throws('NamespaceError', () => element.setAttributeNS(ns, 'xml:lang', 'x'));
  checks.xmlnsError = throws('NamespaceError', () => element.setAttributeNS(ns, 'xmlns', 'x'));
  checks.xml = (element.setAttributeNS('http://www.w3.org/XML/1998/namespace', 'xml:lang', 'en'), element.getAttribute('xml:lang') === 'en');
  checks.invalidLocal = throws('InvalidCharacterError', () => element.setAttributeNS(ns, 'p:bad name', 'x'));
  checks.invalidPrefix = throws('InvalidCharacterError', () => element.setAttributeNS(ns, ':name', 'x'));
  checks.symbol = throws('TypeError', () => element.setAttributeNS(ns, 'p:name', Symbol()));
  checks.required = throws('TypeError', () => element.setAttributeNS(ns, 'p:name')) && throws('TypeError', () => element.getAttributeNS(ns));
  checks.receiver = throws('TypeError', () => Element.prototype.getAttributeNS.call({}, ns, 'name'));
  const calls = []; const tag = 'x-attribute-ns-' + variant;
  customElements.define(tag, class extends HTMLElement {static observedAttributes=['data-observed'];attributeChangedCallback(...args){calls.push(args)}});
  const custom = document.createElement(tag);
  custom.setAttributeNS(ns, 'p:data-observed', 'one'); custom.setAttributeNS(ns, 'q:data-observed', 'two'); custom.removeAttributeNS(ns, 'data-observed');
  checks.customNamespace = JSON.stringify(calls) === JSON.stringify([['data-observed',null,'one',ns],['data-observed','one','two',ns],['data-observed','two',null,ns]]);
  calls.length=0; custom.setAttributeNS(ns, 'p:data-observed', 'start'); calls.length=0; custom.setAttribute('p:data-observed', 'next'); custom.removeAttribute('p:data-observed');
  checks.customQualified = JSON.stringify(calls) === JSON.stringify([['data-observed','start','next',ns],['data-observed','next',null,ns]]);
  const holder = document.createElement('div'); document.body.append(holder);
  const map = holder.attributes, attr = document.createAttribute('DATA-NODE');
  checks.attrBrand = attr instanceof Attr && attr instanceof Node && attr.nodeType === 2;
  checks.attrNames = attr.name === 'data-node' && attr.nodeName === attr.name && attr.localName === attr.name && attr.namespaceURI === null && attr.prefix === null;
  checks.detached = attr.ownerElement === null && attr.ownerDocument === document && attr.specified && !attr.isConnected && attr.parentNode === null && attr.childNodes.length === 0;
  attr.value = 'initial-' + variant;
  checks.attrValues = attr.value === attr.nodeValue && attr.textContent === attr.value;
  checks.mapBrand = map instanceof NamedNodeMap && Object.prototype.toString.call(map) === '[object NamedNodeMap]' && holder.attributes === map && map.length === 0;
  checks.attach = holder.setAttributeNode(attr) === null && attr.ownerElement === holder && map.length === 1;
  checks.identity = map[0] === attr && map.item(0) === attr && map['data-node'] === attr && map.getNamedItem('DATA-NODE') === attr && holder.getAttributeNode('data-node') === attr;
  checks.iteration = [...map].length === 1 && [...map][0] === attr && map.item(123) === null;
  checks.mapKeys = JSON.stringify(Object.keys(map)) === '["0"]' && Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(map, 'data-node').enumerable === false;
  attr.nodeValue = 'updated';
  checks.attachedValue = holder.getAttribute('data-node') === 'updated' && attr.textContent === 'updated';
  holder.setAttribute('data-node', 'setter');
  checks.setterIdentity = holder.getAttributeNode('data-node') === attr && attr.value === 'setter';
  const replacement = document.createAttribute('data-node'); replacement.value = 'replacement';
  checks.replace = map.setNamedItem(replacement) === attr && attr.ownerElement === null && attr.value === 'setter' && map[0] === replacement;
  attr.value = 'detached-only';
  checks.detachIsolation = holder.getAttribute('data-node') === 'replacement';
  checks.sameObject = holder.setAttributeNode(replacement) === replacement && map.length === 1;
  const second = document.createElement('div');
  checks.inUse = throws('InUseAttributeError', () => second.setAttributeNode(replacement)) && replacement.ownerElement === holder && second.attributes.length === 0;
  checks.remove = map.removeNamedItem('DATA-NODE') === replacement && replacement.ownerElement === null && replacement.value === 'replacement' && map.length === 0;
  checks.notFound = throws('NotFoundError', () => holder.removeAttributeNode(replacement)) && throws('NotFoundError', () => map.removeNamedItem('missing'));
  checks.reuse = second.setAttributeNode(replacement) === null && replacement.ownerElement === second && second.getAttribute('data-node') === 'replacement';
  second.removeAttribute('data-node');
  checks.plainRemoval = replacement.ownerElement === null && replacement.value === 'replacement';
  second.setAttribute('data-node', 'new');
  checks.newIdentity = second.getAttributeNode('data-node') !== replacement && replacement.ownerElement === null;
  const namespaced = document.createAttributeNS(ns, 'p:item'); namespaced.value = 'ns-value';
  checks.nsAttr = namespaced.prefix === 'p' && namespaced.localName === 'item' && namespaced.name === 'p:item' && namespaced.namespaceURI === ns;
  checks.nsAttach = map.setNamedItemNS(namespaced) === null && map.getNamedItemNS(ns, 'item') === namespaced && holder.getAttributeNodeNS(ns, 'item') === namespaced;
  holder.setAttributeNS(ns, 'q:item', 'ns-next');
  checks.nsIdentity = namespaced.name === 'p:item' && namespaced.value === 'ns-next' && map[0] === namespaced;
  const nsReplacement = document.createAttributeNS(ns, 'r:item'); nsReplacement.value = 'ns-replaced';
  checks.nsReplace = holder.setAttributeNodeNS(nsReplacement) === namespaced && namespaced.ownerElement === null && map[0] === nsReplacement && holder.getAttributeNS(ns, 'item') === 'ns-replaced' && nsReplacement.name === 'r:item';
  checks.attrNsRemove = map.removeNamedItemNS(ns, 'item') === nsReplacement && nsReplacement.ownerElement === null && map.length === 0;
  const clone = nsReplacement.cloneNode(); clone.value = 'clone';
  checks.attrClone = clone !== nsReplacement && clone.name === nsReplacement.name && clone.namespaceURI === ns && clone.ownerElement === null && nsReplacement.value === 'ns-replaced';
  holder.setAttributeNS(ns, 'style', 'width:99px'); holder.style.width = '23px';
  checks.styleNullMutation = holder.getAttributeNS(ns, 'style') === 'width:99px' && holder.getAttributeNS(null, 'style').includes('23px') && getComputedStyle(holder).width === '23px';
  const styleAttr = holder.getAttributeNodeNS(null, 'style'); styleAttr.value = 'width:35px';
  checks.styleAttrValue = getComputedStyle(holder).width === '35px' && holder.style.width === '35px';
  const idAttr = document.createAttribute('id'); idAttr.value = 'attr-id-' + variant; holder.setAttributeNode(idAttr);
  checks.nativeId = document.getElementById(idAttr.value) === holder && holder.matches('#' + idAttr.value) && window[idAttr.value] === holder;
  idAttr.value = 'next-attr-' + variant;
  checks.nativeIdMutation = document.getElementById('attr-id-' + variant) === null && document.getElementById(idAttr.value) === holder && window[idAttr.value] === holder;
  const observed = document.createAttributeNS(ns, 'p:data-observed'); observed.value = 'attr-start'; calls.length = 0;
  custom.setAttributeNode(observed); observed.value = 'attr-next'; custom.removeAttributeNode(observed);
  checks.attrReactions = JSON.stringify(calls) === JSON.stringify([['data-observed',null,'attr-start',ns],['data-observed','attr-start','attr-next',ns],['data-observed','attr-next',null,ns]]);
  checks.attrErrors = throws('TypeError', () => new Attr()) && throws('TypeError', () => new NamedNodeMap()) && throws('TypeError', () => holder.setAttributeNode({})) && throws('TypeError', () => map.item());
  checks.attrTree = !holder.contains(idAttr) && idAttr.contains(idAttr) && !idAttr.contains(holder) && throws('HierarchyRequestError', () => holder.appendChild(idAttr)) && throws('HierarchyRequestError', () => idAttr.appendChild(holder));
  const upper = document.createAttributeNS(ns, 'P:Upper'); holder.setAttributeNode(upper);
  checks.upperMap = !Reflect.ownKeys(map).includes('P:Upper') && map['P:Upper'] === undefined && map.getNamedItemNS(ns, 'Upper') === upper;
  svg.setAttributeNode(upper.cloneNode());
  checks.svgUpperMap = Reflect.ownKeys(svg.attributes).includes('P:Upper') && svg.attributes['P:Upper'].name === 'P:Upper';
  return checks;
}
